speech.heard: USA has 2.3% of adults with a doctorate. Nigeria has 0.6%. USA has 3.8 times the share seen in Nigeria. It counts everyone 25 and over who completed a doctoral or equivalent degree. Nigeria has 0.6%, sitting above the global median of 0.4%. Switzerland is the world's highest at 3.3%. Germany has 1.9% and Guatemala is the lowest at 0.01%. How many people hold a doctoral degree where you live?
